facts.fact: La Gazette des Comores describes the current civil registration system as still largely manual, with frequent errors, falsifications, lost documents and difficult access to registers; the statement is undated, so the published date is used.
facts.system: système d'état civil (registres de naissance, mariage, décès)

facts.fact: The government adopted in 2024 a Plan stratégique de modernisation de l'état civil, following law n°23-06/AU of 27 July 2023 on digitisation and personal data protection, the article reports.
facts.system: AMECC (Appui à la Modernisation de l'État Civil aux Comores)

facts.fact: The AMECC project has the financial and technical support of France and UNICEF, as stated at the study launch of 10 October 2025.
facts.system: AMECC (Appui à la Modernisation de l'État Civil aux Comores)

facts.fact: The study preceding digitalisation of the civil registration system was launched in Moroni on 2 October 2025 and presented again at Fomboni, Mohéli, on 10 October 2025 for local stakeholders.
facts.system: AMECC (Appui à la Modernisation de l'État Civil aux Comores)

systems.system: AMECC (Appui à la Modernisation de l'État Civil aux Comores)
